intro: Stairs are a representation of life, at least of my life. They speak of growth, of development, and most importantly, of resilience. Every step is a decision, each landing a quiet pause, a moment suspended between where you have been and where you are going.

Stairs are both challenge and beauty. They reveal the poetry of structures, where forces are resolved and engineering becomes something almost lyrical. They are one of the few elements in architecture that demand both precision and emotion, where calculation meets intuition.
It is not a collection of finished work,
but a sequence of steps, projects, explorations, and iterations that build upon one another.
Each one reflects a moment of learning.
Like a staircase, my work moves between precision and intuition,
What you see here is not only what I design,
but how I think, how I test, and how I move forward.
